final_report: Implemented minimal hardening of _run_generate in app/llm/tools.py per the approved plan. (1) Topic grounding: fallback chain arguments.topic -> getattr(ctx, "recent_user_text", "") stripped -> session goal; user prompt now also carries "The topic MUST stay within the current lesson thread ({topic}). Do not choose an unrelated subject." (2) One bounded repair attempt mirroring structured_outputs.request_output: first attempt failure (text None, or parse_exact_json/validate_output raising ModelOutputError/ValidationError/ValueError) appends the assistant echo (original text, or "(no usable answer: {code})" error note) plus a user repair message "Your previous answer could not be used ({stable_code}). Return ONLY corrected JSON for output_kind={kind} about {topic}, matching the schema exactly." and calls complete_json once more; second failure returns {"error": stable_code}. stable_code comes from _issue_code, extended so "Empty model output" maps to "empty_output" (code added to _KNOWN_ERROR_CODES) and the transport split (error_text or "upstream").split(":", 1)[0] is reused verbatim, so provider-code-prefixed transport strings (timeout:, rate_limit:, ...) surface their prefix while unknown prefixes fall through to invalid_output per the existing mapping. (3) Mermaid validate + quiz count logic byte-for-byte identical, applied to whichever attempt succeeded; a defensive if output is None guard returns invalid_output (statically unreachable since attempt-2 failure always returns early). (4) Appended test_execute_tool_generate_todo_repairs_after_empty_output to tests/test_tools_loop.py following existing FakeLLM patterns: scripted complete_json ["", VALID_JSON] for generate_todo asserts validated payload {kind: todo, title, items:[{text, done: False}]}, llm.calls length == 2, second call has 4 messages with assistant echo and exact "could not be used" repair note. turn.py ctx.recent_user_text wiring is intentionally deferred to avoid touching turn.py - getattr fallback covers it. Verification: python -m compileall clean on both files; python -m pytest tests/test_tools_loop.py -q -> 10 passed in 3.12s. No commit.
